show.title: Momo Chutni ka pyaar
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/XbHMXb
show.description: After being brutally humiliated and nearly fried by his street-food rivals, a humble Momo hiding his billionaire status as a "cheap dough ball" undergoes a royal transformation to reclaim his title as the world-renowned "Ming," destroy his enemies' reputations, and find true love with a premium Mayonnaise.
